attributes.name: Razorglass Knife
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 2d4+2. If proficient with weapons and the check is against a non-villain monster, you may bury any number of cards from your discard pile to add 2d4 for each card buried.

When a character at your location plays another weapon on a combat check, recharge this card to add 2d4.
